controls.expected_rejection: A class not descending from Claim 047 must reject.
Any source hash or measurement row change must reject.
A changed census, trace or certificate must reject.
Target access, row selection, uncertainty rescaling or mismatch-as-success must reject.
A deliberately displaced vector or incomplete class key must reject rather than become a passing label.

dimension_unit_boundary.external_reference_protocol: Measured exponents remain post-seal dimensionless records normalized only by their reported standard uncertainties.

evaluation_protocol.acceptance_condition: All five class keys are complete, the fifteen-value residual mean is below the One, and every independent erbium/turbulence check passes without rewarding a displaced material row.
evaluation_protocol.falsification_condition: Reject if a source or dependency changes; any material structural key is incomplete; the complete fifteen-value mean squared residual reaches the One; erbium or turbulence excludes a sealed exponent; either spectrum route is absent; any row is omitted or uncertainty rescaled; La02 displacement is rewarded; or targets alter the survivor.

metrics.definition: Every material retains transition order, interaction range, scaling relation and exponent vector.
All fifteen exponent measurements contribute once to the exact mean squared normalized residual.
Complete independent critical and cascade measurements contain the sealed exact carriers.
metrics.unit_protocol: dimensionless exact rational intervals and route records

external_measurement_sources.measurement_body: Structural, magnetic, and magnetocaloric properties of La and Sm co-doped CaMnO3 manganites
Spectral analysis of structure functions and their scaling exponents in forced isotropic turbulence
Second-order structure function in fully developed turbulence

frozen_relation.candidate_grammar: Generate the complete eight-axis product of class carrier, complete structural-key relation, provenance, custody, proof/measurement separation, all-row retention, successor closure and no extra rule.
frozen_relation.exact_domain: The admitted two-class formal census; complete structural key for each of five manganites; all fifteen manganite exponent values; complete erbium vector; complete turbulence structure interval; both physical spectrum routes; limitations; and every source identity.
frozen_relation.statement: All five manganite structural keys identify the binary local-order mean-field class. The complete fifteen-value mean squared normalized residual is exactly 5286961/10584000, below the One. The erbium beta/gamma/nu intervals contain 1/2, One and 1/2; the turbulence interval contains 2/3; and both physical routes exhibit the registered falling five-thirds plateau. No material mismatch is an acceptance condition.

stop_condition: Halt without admission on a changed source, incomplete class key, unit residual failure, excluded exponent, missing route, omitted row, target access, fitting, uncertainty rescaling, mismatch-as-success or failed control.
